q: What does 谁 mean?
explain: 谁 (shéi) = who. 什么 = what, 哪 = which, 几 = how many.

q: Which character means "which" (as in 你是哪国人)?
explain: 哪 (nǎ) = which. 那 (nà) = that. Check the left side: 口 means a question word.

q: What does 那 mean (那位是谁?)?
explain: 那 (nà) = that. 这 (zhè) = this.

q: Which pinyin is right for 几 (as in 你几岁)?
explain: 几 = jǐ (third tone), "how many".

q: What does 吃 mean?
explain: 吃 (chī) = to eat. 喝 = to drink, 买 = to buy, 看 = to look.

q: What does 买 mean?
explain: 买 (mǎi) = to buy. 去 = to go, 吃 = to eat, 想 = to want.

q: What does 书 mean?
explain: 书 (shū) = book. 钱 = money, 学校 = school, 朋友 = friend.

q: What does 钱 mean?
explain: 钱 (qián) = money. 家 = family/house.

q: In 我今年十九岁, what does 岁 mean?
explain: 岁 (suì) is the measure word for age. 本 is for books, 口 for family members, 个 general.

q: Which pinyin is right for 两 ("two of something")?
explain: 两 = liǎng (third tone). It is used before measure words: 两个孩子.

q: Which character means "very, quite"?
explain: 很 (hěn) = very. 也 = also, 不 = not, 和 = and.

q: What does 也 mean?
explain: 也 (yě) = also: 我也是学生.

q: Fill the blank (I am also a student): 我___是学生。
explain: 也 goes before the verb: Subject + 也 + verb. 吗 ends questions, 的 shows possession.

q: Fill the blank (This is my business card): 这是我___名片。
explain: Pronoun + 的 + noun = possession: 我的名片.

q: Fill the blank (I have three books): 我有三___书。
explain: 本 (běn) is the measure word for books. 岁 is for age, 口 for family members, 位 for people (polite).

q: Fill the blank (I am nineteen years old this year): 我今年十九___。
explain: Age uses 岁: 十九岁.

q: Fill the blank (How old are you?): 你___岁?
explain: 几岁 = how old (asking about a child, or in the course pattern 你几岁?). 几 = how many.

q: What does 学 mean (as in 学习)?
explain: 学 (xué) = to study/learn. 学习 = study, 学生 = student, 学校 = school.

q: Which meaning fits 会 in 她会说中文?
explain: 会 (huì) = can/know how to. 她会说中文 = She can speak Chinese.

q: Which pinyin is right for 说?
explain: 说 = shuō (first tone), "to speak".

q: Which pinyin is right for 去 (to go)?
explain: 去 = qù (fourth tone): 明天她去中国.

q: What is the pinyin of the first character in 好吃 (delicious)?
explain: 好 = hǎo (third tone). 号 (hào, "day number") is a different character.

q: Which character is the number seven?
explain: 七 = qī. 九 = jiǔ, 六 = liù, 四 = sì.

q: What does 大 mean?
explain: 大 (dà) = big. 小 = small, 多 = many, 老 = old.

q: What does 月 mean in 十月五号?
explain: 月 (yuè) = month. 年 = year, 号/日 = day, 星期 = week.

q: Which character means "afternoon"?
explain: 下午 (xiàwǔ) = afternoon. 上午 (shàngwǔ) = morning.

q: What does 中文 mean?
explain: 中文 (zhōngwén) = Chinese language. 中国 = China, 中国人 = Chinese person.

q: What does 哪国人 (nǎ guó rén) ask?
explain: 哪 = which, 国 = country, 人 = person. 你是哪国人? 我是中国人。

q: Which pinyin is right for 想 ("to want")?
explain: 想 = xiǎng (third tone): 我想吃米饭.

q: What does 看 mean (as in 看书)?
choices: to look, to see, to read
explain: 看 (kàn) = to look/see. 看书 = to read.

q: Which is the correct pinyin of 你好?
explain: 你 = nǐ, 好 = hǎo. Both are written with third tone marks.

q: A: 谢谢! B: ___
explain: 谢谢 (thank you) is answered by 不客气 (you are welcome).

q: A: 对不起, 我来晚了! B: ___
explain: 没关系 (it does not matter) answers 对不起 (sorry).

q: Which word means "welcome"?
explain: 欢迎 (huānyíng) = welcome. 再见 = goodbye, 请进 = please come in, 认识 = to know.

q: Fill the blank (Nice to meet you): 很___认识你。
explain: 很高兴认识你 = Nice to meet you. 高兴 (gāoxìng) = glad.

q: A: 你叫什么名字? B: ___
explain: Ask the name with 叫什么名字, answer with 我叫 + name.

q: What does 同事 mean?
explain: 同事 (tóngshì) = colleague. 同学 = classmate, 经理 = manager, 朋友 = friend.

q: Which sentence means "I have two children"?
explain: Use 两 + measure word + noun for two objects: 两个孩子. 二 is not used before 个 here.

q: Which sentence means "I want to eat rice"?
explain: Pattern: subject + 想 + verb + object. 我想吃米饭.

q: Today is Thursday (星期四). Which sentence is right for tomorrow?
explain: 星期四 + 1 = 星期五. Tomorrow = 明天.
